mainEntity.name: Is InfiniSynapse suitable for non-technical business users?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Business users can ask KPI questions in natural language, while initial source modeling and governance setup still benefits from analyst or data engineering support.

mainEntity.name: Is InfiniSynapse a replacement for BI tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not exactly. InfiniSynapse is best used as an execution and automation layer, while BI tools remain strong for dashboard exploration and presentation.

mainEntity.name: How is it different from ChatGPT data analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: InfiniSynapse adds production connectors, persistent memory, and auditable task execution across systems, while ChatGPT is primarily a general-purpose assistant.

mainEntity.name: What are the biggest limitations today?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest limitations are upfront data-source setup requirements and the need for lightweight governance practices to maintain quality at scale.
Teams with recurring multi-source analysis requests and expensive analyst rework usually see the fastest ROI.
